note: Inputs are the 25 isolated Orbit roots the orchestrator sessions filed into (local SQLite/TOML, not fetched datasets) and the blind reason sheet derived from them. code/score.py collect turns the roots into artifacts/assignments.csv, which is committed. Session logs are under output/ (not tracked).

inputs.name: orbit-crew-pref-r015
inputs.source: $HOME/.orbit-crew-pref-r015/<session> on dk-server-1 (CREW_PREF_ORBIT_BASE), one root per session in code/sessions.tsv, workspace ws_crew-pref
inputs.fetch: code/setup.sh, then code/run.sh (one planning-only orchestrator session per root with the bound PROMPT.md)

inputs.name: reasons-blind
inputs.source: data/reasons-blind.csv: crew reasons shuffled, without orchestrator or session, for blind coding
